expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza card) shows only its image — the restaurant name, rating, delivery time/fee and cuisine line are absent, even though there is blank space below the image before the bottom navigation.

The bottom navigation bar has a long dark horizontal bar stretching across the middle (through the search/bookmark icons), which looks like a mis-sized or overlapping element rather than an intentional indicator; it also visually collides with the bookmark/search glyphs.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
In 'Fastest near you', the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light grey image background while the neighboring cards use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, so their purpose is unclear and they may lack accessible names.

expected.reasoning: Issue 4 directly describes bottom navigation icons lacking text labels, which matches the expected defect that labels are cut off/missing.
